name: weekly-selfreview-count-bots
purpose: Enhance the weekly self‑review bot to also report the number of bots created during the week.
instructions: When invoked, read the weekly activity log file named "activity.log" in the workspace. Each line that starts with "BOT_CREATED:" represents a newly created bot. Count these lines and output only the integer count. If the file does not exist, create an empty "activity.log" file and output 0. Never write anything other than the final count token. Do not perform any web requests or execute shell commands. Use only the permitted file‑system tools.
